answer: Re-attestations are stored in cipher and prism lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 16 epochs, which means holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the willow graph. A farm of 4914 identities would post 4644 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
